The '''WorkStar Repulsorlift Skiff''', also known as a '''Drogue''', was a series of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] manufactured by [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]]. They were workstations used by technicians and repairmen to reach lofty emplacements. They were U-shaped enclosures which had plenty of room for tools and parts storage.<ref name="GG11" />

==Characteristics==
[[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] modified these [[Skiff/Legends|skiffs]] to carry two passengers, whose combined weight would cut into the Drogue's cargo capacity. Quiet to operate and with appreciable cross-country performance, SpecForce [[operative]]s were known to use these skiffs during special operations.
